about: What the Lab may do on its own. Agents act freely inside these rules; anything outside becomes a decision card. the owner changes the rules on Board day. Built from AUTHORITY.md (2026-09-03), standing-approvals.json (2026-09-04..15), business.mjs (2026-09-26) and the Lab Autopilot answers (2026-09-27).

maker.name: Maker
maker.why: Invents the toys and owns the Lab's voice.

budget.why: Fewer, better questions. A card either defaults, escalates once, or expires with a note.

money.why: Answer 2, 2026-09-27. Purchases stop at the cart for a person's tap until the owner changes buyingStopsAtCart.

levels.1: ask, with a default after a set time
levels.2: do it, with a recall window
levels.3: just do it and log it

safety.decision.why: Child safety, CPC, choking and age grading never default and never auto-promote.

legal.decision.why: Filings, signatures, regulators, lawyers, privacy and terms. Guard drafts, a person sends.

money.spend.default: put it in the cart, a person buys
money.spend.why: Inside the cap and an approved category. Over the cap becomes money.over-cap.

money.over-cap.why: Over $150 a purchase or $400 a month.

money.recurring.why: Any new subscription, licence or plan.

money.price.why: A price or discount change on a live product.

product.launch.why: A new toy goes on sale only after the Studio safety check, with the owner's signature.

customer.reply.known.why: Order status and answers already on help.html, terms or the order record (was inbox-routine).

customer.reply.new.why: Answer 3, 2026-09-27: silence means send after 4 h.

customer.text.ack.why: The fixed acknowledgement template only (was sms-ack).

market.email.why: Answer 3, 2026-09-27. Anything with a fee is money.spend.

market.comms.why: Countdowns and thank-yous for a market booked and paid. Shadow run 2026-09-27: 2 of 5 rejected because the Leander market had been cancelled; stays at ask until the gateway checks the booking itself.

market.commit.why: Booking, withdrawing or changing a market the Lab is committed to.

social.post.why: A post in an approved series with a real photo or approved reel (was social-queue). Shadow run 2026-09-27: all 4 series posts got changes, so it starts at ask and earns the 1 h recall after 5 clean.

social.new.why: A post outside an approved series. Silence means it waits.

social.engage.why: Likes and comments on X and Instagram (x-engagement, ig-engagement). Don't get flagged.

social.mirror.why: Every Instagram reel also goes to YouTube as a Short (youtube-mirror).

blog.post.why: Lab Notes on the calendar; the claims gate still runs. Shadow run 2026-09-27: 1 of 5 approved as written, so it starts at ask and earns the 2 h recall after 3 clean.

press.partner.why: Press replies, partnerships, ads, giveaways, new claims about the business.

site.deploy.why: Content, fixes and approved-plan features, only through the clean-worktree deploy and the claims gate.

site.feature.why: New customer-facing features, or anything touching payment, checkout, login or data collection.

farm.plan.why: Scheduling and re-planning prints. Printer safety checks are never overridden.

business.decision.why: Everything else that needs a call: the recommendation stands if nobody objects in 3 days.

crew.internal.why: Agents' own tools, schemas, deploys of internal code. Never reaches a person.

hands.task.why: Physical work goes to the Lab wall as walks, not to the decision queue.

drop.marketing.why: Mailing lists and sales pitches need no answer; don't draft replies.

never.text: Enter card or bank details, or move money between accounts.
Sell a product without a CPC.
See, store or repeat a secret value.
Use an illustration as a product photo.
Promise a date, price or feature that is not real.
Override a printer's safety check or send IGNORE_* to a printer.

channels.texts: urgent only: safety, fire, a customer waiting over a day
channels.pulse: the only place a person is asked anything

checks.unverified: An action tagged 'unverified' (a draft that cites something not on the record) is always asked, with no default, whatever its class. Shadow run 2026-09-27: a text quoting an insurance figure not in the facts.
